name: resolve402
description: French company directors with business email, people search, counterparty checks (KYB) and hiring signals. Paid per call with x402.
long_description: Resolve402 gives agents official French company data in one paid call: decision makers with their probable business email (RNE registry), people search by sector, place and size, counterparty checks before invoicing or paying (VAT via VIES, insolvency via BODACC, DG Trésor asset freezes, IBAN), hiring signals from public ATS boards, and document tools. Paid per call with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). Not found = not charged. Nothing stored.

tools.name: find_decision_makers
tools.description: French company directors with their probable business email (official RNE registry).

tools.name: people_search
tools.description: Decision makers of French companies by role, sector, place and headcount.

tools.name: counterparty_check
tools.description: Check a company before invoicing or paying it: status, VAT, insolvency, sanctions, IBAN.

tools.name: hiring_signals
tools.description: Open jobs from a company's public ATS board, summarized as buying signals.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Email pre-check: syntax, MX, provider, disposable, webmail, role account.

tools.name: doc_to_markdown
tools.description: PDF, DOCX, HTML or TXT to clean Markdown with tables.

tools.name: markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Render Markdown into a clean PDF.
